request.query: query Ticket($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { identifier title description priority assignee { id displayName } creator { id displayName } botActor { name } externalUserCreator { name } labels(first: 50) { nodes { name } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } }

issue.description:
**Why.** P1 works real tickets from Owlshift's own Linear workspace.

**Scope:**

* Read a ticket: title, description, priority, assignee, labels, comments with author and last-edit time.
* Post a comment.
* Declare the adapter's capabilities ([architecture](<https://github.com/pitchopp/owlshift/blob/main/docs/design/architecture.md>) section 6).
* The API key comes from the system keychain.

**Acceptance.** Recorded HTTP fixtures, plus a first tracker conformance suite the adapter passes.
issue.title: Add the Linear tracker adapter: read a ticket and post a comment

request.query: query Ticket($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { identifier title description priority assignee { id displayName } creator { id displayName } botActor { name } externalUserCreator { name } labels(first: 50) { nodes { name } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } }

query Comments($id: String!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { issue(id: $id) { comments(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id body createdAt editedAt user { id displayName } botActor { name } externalUser { name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
